title: Samsung India increases the prices of entry-level Galaxy A, F and M-series models
description: Analysts were warning about this – entry-level smartphones are the most sensitive to increases in component costs. And we’re now seeing the effects of the RAM and storage shortages as Samsung India has quietly increased the prices of its entry-level models. This affects the low-end (06, 07 and 17) models in the Galaxy A, F and M series. Both 4G and 5G versions too. title: EU's Starlink alternative gets the green light, deployment will start in 2029
description: The European Commission has finalized the plans for the EU's sovereign IRIS satellite broadband service. The plan outlines the detailed design of the satellite constellation, the preparation for satellite production and the development of the ground infrastructure and launch services involved. The EU Commission has also signed an agreement with European manufacturers and the European Space Agency (ESA) after starting negotiations in January this year. The agreements also define the target pricing for each satellite and the needed investment from private operators. Interestingly, the...

title: Sony is working on a surprising pair of WH-1000X headphones, here's how much they'll cost
description: Sony launched the WH-1000XM4 headphones in 2020, and they've since been discontinued as they were first replaced by the WH-1000XM5 and then the WH-1000XM6, which just received a new color a few days ago. However, it now seems like Sony plans to revive the WH-1000XM4, and relaunch them as the WH-1000XM4C. This product will allegedly be released on September 7 for €249.99 or £219.99. The original Sony WH-1000XM4 In Euros, that makes these €100 cheaper than the original WH-1000XM4 were when they launched all those years ago. title: Google's new Pixel Watch video teaser makes fun of its competitors' looks
description: In just a few days, on August 12, Google will unveil the Pixel 11 family and the Pixel Watch 5. Ahead of that, the company has today published a new video teaser for the watch on its YouTube channel. It's short and to the point, as you can see. And the point? Well, the point is to poke fun at the Samsung Galaxy Watches and the Apple Watches of the world with their weird shapes that aren't really very watch-like. The Pixel Watch 5, on the other hand? This one "has the decency to look like a watch". And it does that while still tracking your health, sleep, and fitness. So the obvious...

title: SK Hynix promises to invest over $38 billion in new DRAM and NAND fabs
description: The chip shortage is very much still a thing, and it could even affect Apple's iPhone 18 Pro launch next month. Now, SK Hynix, one of the three major DRAM and NAND manufacturers, has announced that it will invest in a new DRAM and a new NAND fab. The former represents a KRW 35.2 trillion (approximately $25 billion) investment, while the latter is a KRW 19.1 trillion (approximately $13.5 billion) investment. The DRAM fab is expected to open in June 2029, while the NAND fab is expected to open in December 2028. So, while such investments are definitely welcome, they will not solve the...

title: This is the Motorola Edge 70 Neo, leaked renders show four colors
description: Motorola may have teased the upcoming Edge 70 Neo in a very unusual way recently, but the phone is still not official. Even so, we now have a few leaked renders of it to look at. They show the device in four colors, and reveal that it will have a 200MP camera. The screen's sides are curved, but at a very steep angle, so they appear to be less curved, if that makes sense. The rear design is standard 2026 Motorola fare, with a raised squarish camera island in the top left corner. Unfortunately, nothing is known about the specs of the Edge 70 Neo aside from what that 200MP...

title: Samsung now lets you send Samsung Wallet items through Quick Share
description: Samsung's latest update to the Quick Share app for its smartphones and tablets is now rolling out and it comes with a new feature. You can now share Samsung Wallet items through Quick Share. This includes tickets and boarding passes. So you can much more easily send someone a ticket to an event or a boarding pass for a flight by simply using Quick Share. The latest Quick Share update also unsurprisingly brings some bug fixes. Keep in mind that the rollout seems to be staged, so it may take a while until it reaches all supported devices. To manually check for the update, go to the...

title: Samsung continues to lead the global DRAM market in Q2 2026
description: According to Counterpoint's report on the second quarter of this year, Samsung is great winner from the rising DRAM prices in the same quarter. The Korean tech giant is widening the gap between itself and its biggest competitor, SK Hynix. In Q2 2026, Samsung captured 39% of the global DRAM sales and secured the first spot for a third quarter in a row. The Korean company is followed by SK Hynix, securing 26% of the sales, which in turn is closely followed by Micron with a 25% share. CMXT gets only 7%, and the remaining share goes to other smaller manufacturers. Counterpoint's...

title: Apple just raised the trade-in values for iPhones, Watches, Macs, and iPads
description: Apple has increased the trade-in values of most iPhones, iPads, Macs, and Watches in the US. The list also includes some Android smartphones from Samsung, Google, and OnePlus. The Watch Ultra 2, Mac Pro, iPhone 16 Pro Max, and the iPad Pro are the Apple devices that currently have the highest trade-in values. However, note that the trade-in values of some products remain unchanged, and the values mentioned by Apple on its website aren't flat discount rates; they are estimated trade-in values, so you might get less than what's mentioned as the values will "vary based on the condition, year,...

title: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra2 review
Redmi 17C 5G shows up as a rebrand of another device
description: The Redmi 17C 4G launched back in June, and now the Redmi 17C 5G was spotted in a listing in Luxembourg. The 5G version comes with a 6.9-inch 720x1600 LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and an 810-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC, paired with 4GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 64/128GB of UFS 2.2 storage. There's a 50MP f/1.8 main camera on the rear and an 8MP selfie camera on the front, and the battery capacity is 6,000 mAh, charging at 33W. Redmi 17C 5G official images The phone runs HyperOS 3. title: Shortage of DRAM could limit iPhone 18 Pro availability at launch
description: Continuing the thread of yesterday's report that Apple is short on DRAM for its upcoming iPhones, there's more to the story. Apple could likely have limited iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max availability at launch. Per Culpium, the iPhone 18 Pro models and the foldable iPhone Ultra will use the new A20 Pro SoC, based on TSMC's N2 node. TSMC has reportedly been able to progress well with volume and yields, but wafers are piling up waiting for DRAM to be packaged on the chips. Apple is scrambling to supply DRAM from Micron, SK Hynix, and Samsung, and is even exploring Chinese-sourced avenues like...

title: Samsung unveils ISOCELL HPC, its first sensor with DeepPix technology
description: Samsung has unveiled its new flagship mobile image sensor, the ISOCELL HPC, featuring the industry's first DeepPix technology that enables 16-bit RAW output. The company claims the new sensor delivers improved dynamic range and enhanced low-light performance. The ISOCELL HPC is a 200MP camera sensor with a 1/1.3-inch optical format and 0.6μm pixels. Samsung says the new sensor captures significantly more light than its predecessor thanks to its new DeepPix technology. According to the company, DeepPix allows each pixel to hold more light before becoming overexposed, resulting in...

title: Google Wallet now lets you set up a dedicated balance for your kids and teens
description: Today Google Wallet is introducing a new feature in the US. Parents can set up a secure balance on Google Wallet for their kids and teens under 18. Once they do that, the kids and teens can tap to pay with Google Pay using their Android and Wear OS devices. Note that this only works through NFC, so online transactions are not supported. This means there's no need to get the kids or teens a card or anything like that - this is all inside Google Wallet. Parents have full control over their kids' balance and activity through Family Link. As a parent, you easily transfer...

title: Indian iQOO Z11's processor officially confirmed, and it's different from other models
description: Last month, a media report claimed that the iQOO Z11 - launching in India on August 20 - will be powered by the Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, making it the first smartphone in India to have that MediaTek chip at the helm. Well, that report turned out to be correct, as iQOO has announced that the Indian Z11 will have the Dimensity 7500 Turbo under the hood. In comparison, the Chinese and Malaysian Z11 are powered by the Dimensity 8500 and Snapdragon 7s Gen 4, respectively. Power that thinks faster. ⚡🧠Meet the all-new iQOO Z11, powered by India's First MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo Processor*...

title: ChatGPT gives free users unlimited text chats while improving its flagship model
description: Today, OpenAI has announced that ChatGPT users on the free version (as well as the cheapest Go paid tier) will get unlimited text chats with no automatic switching to a lesser model. Speaking of models, GPT-5.6 Luna, the smallest of the three GPT-5.6 models released in July, will become the default for the free and Go users, taking over from the ancient (in AI terms) GPT-5.5 Instant. The switch to GPT-5.6 Luna will take place at some point this week, while the unlimited text chats will be available next week, which is also when free and Go users will get access to a new Think button. This...

title: Oppo kicks off ColorOS 17 Closed Beta Testing, device list and rollout dates confirmed
description: With Android 17 Beta officially out for Pixel devices, smartphone manufacturers are launching their own closed beta testing programs. Oppo announced the ColorOS 17 CBT for certain Oppo, OnePlus and Realme devices. This comes after Realme officially confirmed that moving forward, all Realme phones will be running ColorOS. The same goes for OnePlus phones, where they still sell. So if you are a OnePlus or Realme user who wants to take an early taste of ColorOS 17, or you just want to try out the latest OS on your Oppo flagship, then you need to be quick. title: Ask Maps in Google Maps can now order food for you and remember your past conversations
description: Google launched the Gemini-powered Ask Maps function in Google Maps back in March, and today it's receiving a massive set of improvements. Chief among these is the ability to order food directly from the app. You can just tell Ask Maps what you want to eat, and it will find open restaurants along your route that serve what you're craving. Once you select a restaurant, Ask Maps can add the dish you want directly to your cart so you can then review and complete your order. This is rolling out "with partners like Square and Toast, with Uber Eats coming soon", according to...

title: POCO Carnival 2026 Celebrates Eight Years of Bold Innovation, From 8 to ∞
description: POCO is a fan-driven smartphone brand and every year it celebrates the community around its phones with the annual POCO Carnival. This fan festival is an opportunity for people to get together, to engage with the brand, to discuss innovations and to see what’s next. The theme this year is “From 8 to ∞” and focuses on POCO F8 Series, X8 Pro Series and M8 Series models. The Carnival will showcase the cutting-edge designs of these phones and how their features answer the real-world needs of young tech enthusiasts. title: Freshly leaked Samsung Galaxy S26 FE renders show all three colors
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has just been certified by the FCC, and now we have a new set of leaked renders that portray it in three colors. According to the source of this leak, these will be all the hues in which the Galaxy S26 FE will be offered. Unsurprisingly, the Galaxy S26 FE goes with the same updated camera design as the Galaxy S26 and S26+. There's now an oval-shaped island onto which the three cameras are mounted.
